source_locator: Page 1, Summary, Mayoral race, Total Votes column; 108 boxes of 108
verification_note: City summary report (108 of 108 boxes, including early vote, printed May 16, 2011): Adame 9,442 (71.88 percent), Moon 2,386 (18.16 percent), Madrigal 1,308 (9.96 percent); total 13,136. Adame won a majority, so no runoff for mayor. The report gives surnames only. The election date May 14, 2011 comes from the Texas Secretary of State Election Advisory No. 2011-03, which states the May 14, 2011 uniform election date; the city report prints no election date. The report is not marked official or certified.
total_votes_basis: sum of all three mayoral candidates, citywide, election day plus early vote (Total Votes in Race)
